name: Being Ashamed
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to trust in the Lord without shame, as David prays for deliverance in righteousness and Paul boldly declares he is not ashamed of the gospel, which is the power of God for salvation. However, there is a solemn warning that those who deny or are ashamed of Christ and His words will face rejection by Him at His coming in glory. God's love is demonstrated in Christ's sacrificial death for sinners, underscoring the confidence believers can have in standing unashamed before God.
